newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Monday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened on the money market after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of the Bank of Canada's 2.75-3.25 percent target range for the rate.
One dealer with a bank-owned brokerage said cash requirements in the U.S. market were drawing some money out of Canada and putting pressure on the overnight market.
"I don't think it's a serious issue," said the dealer. "It's not something fundamental happening in our market."
Canada's three month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 2.98 percent in the wake of the intervention.
